content.short: Bodega Market is a Cardano prediction market for creating, trading, and settling event outcomes with wallets.
content.description: Bodega Market is a Cardano prediction market where users can speculate on outcomes of real-world or community-driven events. Participants can buy and sell shares as probabilities change, then track positions and results in real time. The platform uses Cardano's settlement layer to bring transparency and wallet-based access to event markets. Its core purpose is to turn forecasts, opinions, and new information into tradeable prediction markets rather than standard token swaps, simple polls, or informal bets.
